    // The counter-clockwise rotation about `centerPoint`, which stays fixed.
    // Deviation: no quarter-turn snapping (see the file header).
    CreateRotation(_: Matrix3x2, angle: Angle, centerPoint: Point2D): Matrix3x2 {
        var c = angle.Cos;
        var s = angle.Sin;
        return (Number2(c, s),
                Number2(-s, c),
                Number2(centerPoint.X * (1.0 - c) + centerPoint.Y * s,
                        centerPoint.Y * (1.0 - c) - centerPoint.X * s));
    }

    //==
    // # Matrix4x4 — the 3D homogeneous map
    //
    // Four Number4 rows: a 3x3 linear block plus a translation row (Row4) and a
    // projective column. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformation_matrix

    // The determinant, by the Laplace expansion along the first row with the six
    // 2x2 minors of the bottom two rows shared between the four cofactors.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Determinant
    Determinant(self: Matrix4x4): Number {
        var m11 = self.Row1.X; var m12 = self.Row1.Y; var m13 = self.Row1.Z; var m14 = self.Row1.W;
        var m21 = self.Row2.X; var m22 = self.Row2.Y; var m23 = self.Row2.Z; var m24 = self.Row2.W;
        var m31 = self.Row3.X; var m32 = self.Row3.Y; var m33 = self.Row3.Z; var m34 = self.Row3.W;
        var m41 = self.Row4.X; var m42 = self.Row4.Y; var m43 = self.Row4.Z; var m44 = self.Row4.W;
        var kpLo = m33 * m44 - m34 * m43;
        var jpLn = m32 * m44 - m34 * m42;
        var joKn = m32 * m43 - m33 * m42;
        var ipLm = m31 * m44 - m34 * m41;
        var ioKm = m31 * m43 - m33 * m41;
        var inJm = m31 * m42 - m32 * m41;
        return m11 * (m22 * kpLo - m23 * jpLn + m24 * joKn)
             - m12 * (m21 * kpLo - m23 * ipLm + m24 * ioKm)
             + m13 * (m21 * jpLn - m22 * ipLm + m24 * inJm)
             - m14 * (m21 * joKn - m22 * ioKm + m23 * inJm);
    }

    // The matrix with rows and columns exchanged.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transpose
    Transpose(self: Matrix4x4): Matrix4x4
        => (Number4(self.Row1.X, self.Row2.X, self.Row3.X, self.Row4.X),
            Number4(self.Row1.Y, self.Row2.Y, self.Row3.Y, self.Row4.Y),
            Number4(self.Row1.Z, self.Row2.Z, self.Row3.Z, self.Row4.Z),
            Number4(self.Row1.W, self.Row2.W, self.Row3.W, self.Row4.W));

    // Element-wise sum.
    Add(value1: Matrix4x4, value2: Matrix4x4): Matrix4x4
        => (value1.Row1 + value2.Row1,
            value1.Row2 + value2.Row2,
            value1.Row3 + value2.Row3,
            value1.Row4 + value2.Row4);

    // Element-wise difference.
    Subtract(value1: Matrix4x4, value2: Matrix4x4): Matrix4x4
        => (value1.Row1 - value2.Row1,
            value1.Row2 - value2.Row2,
            value1.Row3 - value2.Row3,
            value1.Row4 - value2.Row4);

    // Composition of two homogeneous maps: applying the result is applying
    // value1 then value2. Under the row-vector convention that is exactly each
    // row of value1 carried through value2.
    Multiply(value1: Matrix4x4, value2: Matrix4x4): Matrix4x4
        => (value1.Row1.Transform(value2),
            value1.Row2.Transform(value2),
            value1.Row3.Transform(value2),
            value1.Row4.Transform(value2));

    // Every element scaled.
    Multiply(value1: Matrix4x4, f: Number): Matrix4x4
        => (value1.Row1 * f, value1.Row2 * f, value1.Row3 * f, value1.Row4 * f);

    // Every element scaled, with the scalar on the left.
    Multiply(f: Number, value1: Matrix4x4): Matrix4x4
        => value1 * f;

    // Every element divided. Matches System.Numerics: the reciprocal is formed
    // once and multiplied through.
    Divide(value1: Matrix4x4, f: Number): Matrix4x4
        => value1 * (1.0 / f);

    // Element-wise linear interpolation; `amount` is unclamped. Interpolating
    // rigid transforms this way is not rigid — decompose and interpolate the
    // parts if that matters.
    Lerp(self: Matrix4x4, matrix2: Matrix4x4, amount: Number): Matrix4x4
        => (self.Row1 + (matrix2.Row1 - self.Row1) * amount,
            self.Row2 + (matrix2.Row2 - self.Row2) * amount,
            self.Row3 + (matrix2.Row3 - self.Row3) * amount,
            self.Row4 + (matrix2.Row4 - self.Row4) * amount);

    // The combined hash of the four rows.
    Hash(self: Matrix4x4): Integer
        => self.Row1.Hash.CombineHash(self.Row2.Hash)
            .CombineHash(self.Row3.Hash).CombineHash(self.Row4.Hash);

    //==
    // # Matrix4x4 inversion

    // The 4x4 matrix with every element NaN: what a failed inversion returns,
    // matching System.Numerics.
    NotANumber(_: Matrix4x4): Matrix4x4 {
        var n = 0.0 / 0.0;
        return (Number4(n, n, n, n), Number4(n, n, n, n), Number4(n, n, n, n), Number4(n, n, n, n));
    }

    // The adjugate: the transpose of the cofactor matrix, so that
    // Adjugate * (1 / Determinant) is the inverse. Defined for every matrix,
    // singular or not. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adjugate_matrix
    Adjugate(self: Matrix4x4): Matrix4x4 {
        var m11 = self.Row1.X; var m12 = self.Row1.Y; var m13 = self.Row1.Z; var m14 = self.Row1.W;
        var m21 = self.Row2.X; var m22 = self.Row2.Y; var m23 = self.Row2.Z; var m24 = self.Row2.W;
        var m31 = self.Row3.X; var m32 = self.Row3.Y; var m33 = self.Row3.Z; var m34 = self.Row3.W;
        var m41 = self.Row4.X; var m42 = self.Row4.Y; var m43 = self.Row4.Z; var m44 = self.Row4.W;
        // The 2x2 minors of rows 3 and 4 ...
        var kpLo = m33 * m44 - m34 * m43;
        var jpLn = m32 * m44 - m34 * m42;
        var joKn = m32 * m43 - m33 * m42;
        var ipLm = m31 * m44 - m34 * m41;
        var ioKm = m31 * m43 - m33 * m41;
        var inJm = m31 * m42 - m32 * m41;
        // ... of rows 2 and 4 ...
        var gpHo = m23 * m44 - m24 * m43;
        var fpHn = m22 * m44 - m24 * m42;
        var foGn = m22 * m43 - m23 * m42;
        var epHm = m21 * m44 - m24 * m41;
        var eoGm = m21 * m43 - m23 * m41;
        var enFm = m21 * m42 - m22 * m41;
        // ... and of rows 2 and 3.
        var glHk = m23 * m34 - m24 * m33;
        var flHj = m22 * m34 - m24 * m32;
        var fkGj = m22 * m33 - m23 * m32;
        var elHi = m21 * m34 - m24 * m31;
        var ekGi = m21 * m33 - m23 * m31;
        var ejFi = m21 * m32 - m22 * m31;
        return (Number4(m22 * kpLo - m23 * jpLn + m24 * joKn,
                        -(m12 * kpLo - m13 * jpLn + m14 * joKn),
                        m12 * gpHo - m13 * fpHn + m14 * foGn,
                        -(m12 * glHk - m13 * flHj + m14 * fkGj)),
                Number4(-(m21 * kpLo - m23 * ipLm + m24 * ioKm),
                        m11 * kpLo - m13 * ipLm + m14 * ioKm,
                        -(m11 * gpHo - m13 * epHm + m14 * eoGm),
                        m11 * glHk - m13 * elHi + m14 * ekGi),
                Number4(m21 * jpLn - m22 * ipLm + m24 * inJm,
                        -(m11 * jpLn - m12 * ipLm + m14 * inJm),
                        m11 * fpHn - m12 * epHm + m14 * enFm,
                        -(m11 * flHj - m12 * elHi + m14 * ejFi)),
                Number4(-(m21 * joKn - m22 * ioKm + m23 * inJm),
                        m11 * joKn - m12 * ioKm + m13 * inJm,
                        -(m11 * foGn - m12 * eoGm + m13 * enFm),
                        m11 * fkGj - m12 * ekGi + m13 * ejFi));
    }

    // True when the matrix has an inverse: the determinant is a real number and
    // no smaller in magnitude than Number.Epsilon, the same threshold Invert uses.
    CanInvert(self: Matrix4x4): Boolean {
        var det = self.Determinant;
        return !det.IsNaN && det.Abs >= Number.Epsilon;
    }
